source:
Ever Benevolent Lord! 

Oh Blessed Mother Mary! 

Holiest Spirit and all the Saints on Heaven High! 

Words! Words! My words fail to express the gratitude brimming in me soul. I’ve looked to many morrows for this day, and the road has risen to meet me, by your Grace! 

Bless Mr. Langley! Bless him for making me a business partner of Langley Emporium. For giving me the opportunity to rise from pennyboy to partner, allowing me to lend me own business savvy. I thank ye Lord for giving me the wits to recognize many-a-good deal. Through your divine will, ye gave me the vision to see that reinvesting store profit to import factory-made typewriters, sowing machines, and those new work jeans would grow sales by four fold! 

We are now the largest general goods enterprise in town!   

The sacrifice. The faith… all those early days with an empty stomach, pulling the devil by the tail, ignoring the lure of drink and young totties about town… I remained faithful to Your plan for me oh Lord! 

Amen I say. I’ll be at the altar every first Friday. I vow this. I am the happiest man in all your green earth! Amen!
target:
永远仁慈的主！

噢，蒙福的圣母玛利亚！

至圣的圣灵，以及天上所有圣人！

言语！言语！我的言语道不尽灵魂里满溢的感激。我盼过无数个明天，终于等到这一天。蒙祢恩典，道路终于在我脚下展开！

保佑兰利先生！保佑他，让我成为兰利百货店的合伙人。给我机会，从赚铜板的小工升为合伙人，让我运用自己的生意头脑。感谢主，赐我辨识好买卖的智慧。透过祢神圣的旨意，祢让我看见：把商店利润再投入，进口工厂制造的打字机、缝纫机，以及那些新式工作牛仔裤，便能让销售额增至四倍！

如今，我们是镇上最大的综合百货商行！

那些牺牲，那份信仰……早年饿着肚子，在困境中挣扎，不理会酒与镇上年轻姑娘的诱惑……噢，主啊，我始终忠于祢为我安排的计划！

我说，阿们。我会在每个月第一个星期五来到祭坛前，我立誓。我是祢这片翠绿大地上最幸福的男人！阿们！

Sadie: I saw a white raccoon yesterday, so I thought of this story: A white raccoon lived in the dark forest outside of town. The raccoon was sooooo white because it was really an angel. One of God’s angels who was placed into a raccoon’s soul. The angel wanted to play in the woods and enjoy being an animal in God’s land, but he was too white and all the bobcats and coyotes could see him when he left the bushes. So the raccoon hid and was very sad. One day, a little girl saw him and chased after him. It was the most fun the raccoon had in all its life. The girl and the raccoon became friends and when the raccoon died the angel in his soul watched over the girl. The end.

source: Sadie: Daaaaaa

Tomorrow. It must be tomorrow. Tomorrow. Cease this cowardice you old goat. Look at your bruises in the mirror – all sorts of coppery hues aching for weeks. She will appreciate the gesture. You’re getting longer in the tooth and riper for claim by the Good Lord or the Devil, so act while you have your faculties. Another brawl may be your last, so be prudent. Bow out. What I’ll do… what I’ll do is walk into Vivienne’s Cabaret tomorrow morning and respectfully resign my position as “chief of security.” Then, as a sign of my unfaltering respect and gratitude, I’ll gift this green pendant necklace to Claudette. She’s like a beautiful gale. Whipping my old sails into making some headway through life. Were it not for her trust in my character, I fear, by now, I would have drowned in the bottle. Lord knows she gave a broken man the salve of some purpose... Pride swells in my heart. Does she know my gaze? Does she sense my admiration, as a father would adore the success of his child? Ah, well, tomorrow then. This lovely gem necklace from that mysterious prisoner can, at last, enjoy a lovely home upon her neck. And relieve me of its pained memory.
target: 明天。一定要是明天。 明天。 别再胆小了，你这老山羊。看看镜子里那些瘀青——各种铜色，痛了好几星期。 她会感激这份心意的。你越来越老，越来越接近被仁慈的主或魔鬼收走的时候，趁脑袋还清醒，快行动。再打一场，可能就是最后一场了，明智点。退下吧。 我要做的……就是明天早上走进薇薇安歌舞酒馆，恭敬地辞去「保安主管」一职。 然后，把这条绿色坠饰项链送给克劳黛特，表达我始终不变的敬意与感谢。 她像一阵美丽的强风，鼓起我老旧的帆，让人生还能向前。要不是她信任我的为人，恐怕如今我早已溺死在酒瓶里。上帝知道，她给了一个破碎的男人些许目标，抚平他的伤口…… 骄傲涌满我的心。她懂我的目光吗？她感觉得到我的欣赏吗？就像父亲看见孩子成功时，那份深深的喜爱。 啊，好吧，就明天。那个神秘囚犯留下的美丽宝石项链，终于能在她颈间找到美好的归宿。 也让我放下它承载的痛苦回忆。

source: Fools! Imbeciles! Small-town, small-witted simpletons! Why, according to this letter, the numbskulls on town council actually did it. They terminated me from my own project, my own vision. Oh, how they spit on Huck and soil their own legacy! Monuments are borne of time and artistic obsession – history-making is not rushed. Huck employs strikebreakers after a few local wage disputes and suddenly a magnificent, everlasting dome is no longer needed? The project can be abandoned without its crown? Left as a round foundation and walls? And, oh my – Ha – Huck is now, somehow, a villain to the everyman!? Rubbish! HUCK IS THE DOME! HUCK IS THE CONCRETE! SMEED IS FOREVER! Well, well, well then, Asbury, prepare to knuckle up with old Huck! Slander. Stolen intellectual property. Municipal uh… corruption. Yes, yes, abuses of office! Oh, Huck will use every red cent from Smeed Concrete to bleed this town with lawsuits. Whatever it takes, Huck will manifest his vision, his opus, which will outlive this backwater nothingburg!
